name: Makihara Yayoi
source: Her husband has to leave the house for a year because of his job. When she discovered that her neighbor Sae was having affairs with several young boys she tried to protect her son, Yuuta, from her.
translation: Her husband has to leave the house for a year because of his job. When she discovered that her neighbor Sae was having affairs with several young boys she tried to protect her son, Yuuta, from her.
